source_snapshot.items: FIO 50% write/50% read QD1 512B one job
source_snapshot.procedure: randrw with `rwmixread=70`, 43,200 seconds, no target/size and ./fio.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires rwmixread=50 correction, disposable target, authorization and thresholds.

old_problem: The named equal mix conflicts with a literal 70% read/30% write job, while destructive target, bounds and limits are unbound.
disposition_reason: ED-04 protects destructive storage but cannot choose between title coverage and the explicit `rwmixread=70` command. Changing the ratio alters both read/write performance coverage and write endurance exposure; source-owner authority is required.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row5 all18 XLSX cells and history2621.
Preserved the exact 50/50 title and literal 70/30 command as conflicting evidence.
Did not run fio or infer target/threshold.

test_case.test_name: FIO QD1 512B equal-mix SSD validation pending ratio authority
test_case.purpose: Measure read/write IOPS, bandwidth and latency for the authoritative mixed-random ratio on one approved disposable SSD.
required_package: Pinned fio binary/version and approved job hash
Exact disposable non-OS target, serial/topology, bounded extent and access mode
Authorized duration and ratio-specific read/write/latency thresholds
Data-loss approval, health abort policy and storage-owner recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not run the contradictory job. After ratio authority is recorded, verify the selected serial/path is disposable and not OS/boot/mounted/in RAID/in use, capture health, execute the bounded QD1 512B one-job profile once, retain fio JSON plus telemetry, and do not recreate or remount storage automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The authorized ratio executes only on the named disposable target, all approved metrics pass, and no media/platform error is introduced.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the approved ratio and ratio-matched thresholds. A 70/30 result cannot be reported as 50/50, and an unthresholded score cannot pass.
safety_gate: Block until ratio and destructive authorization are explicit.
Pin filename/size/runtime and recheck serial before launch.
Abort on SMART/media/thermal/power limits; never retry automatically.
expected_evidence: Ratio decision and fio job hash
fio JSON with actual read/write mix and metrics
test_case.recovery: If observed I/O mix differs from the approved ratio, stop the job, preserve fio JSON and device-health counters, keep the tested volume isolated, and require the storage owner to decide whether its contents or performance state must be reinitialized before reuse.

source_conflict.reason: 50/50 title and explicit rwmixread=70 continue to define different workloads.

blocked.reason: Ratio authority plus safe project inputs can be supplied.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: After ratio decision, bind target, extent, duration, thresholds and recovery.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION RETAINED; DESTRUCTIVE FIO NOT EXECUTED
pending.owner: Storage testcase owner and project storage owner.
pending.unlock_condition: Approve one ratio as authoritative and provide its destructive-test configuration.
